description: Prompt-injection detection in images (rendered and hidden text, image-scaling attacks, plus container checks), served through the image-forensics /v1/inspect API. The expected endpoints are POST /v1/inspect and GET /readyz; suppliers MAY expose more but consumers MUST NOT depend on it. Each response reports which composed checks ran (upstreams) and where each finding was located. This service is model-agnostic: suppliers choose their own OCR model and prompt-injection classifier, so verdicts vary and are not guaranteed by the protocol; each response carries a pipeline_fingerprint naming both.

rpc_types.backend_hint: image-forensics service on :8000 (image-forensics-service, endpoints.inspect enabled, with OCR and classifier upstreams configured); mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Only POST /v1/inspect and GET /readyz are expected. Request body is multipart/form-data with exactly one of media (file) or media_base64; url sources are off by default and MUST NOT be relied on. A clean verdict is container-only unless upstreams.ocr.status is ok.

serving.backend: Any server exposing POST /v1/inspect and GET /readyz with the request/response shape of the OpenAPI document in specs[1]. Recommended: image-forensics-service with endpoints.inspect enabled, composed with the supplier's own image-inference-server (OCR, as in optical-character-recognition) and language-forensics-service (classifier, as in model-based-prompt-injection-detection). No specific weights are mandated. The operator is responsible for the licenses of the models they serve.
serving.notes: Both upstreams MUST be configured; without them the endpoint degrades to container checks. Point them at your own backends directly, not through Pocket relays. Recommended models: PP-OCRv6 medium (Apache-2.0) and Horizon-Labs prompt-injection-guard base (Apache-2.0). Keep image URL fetching disabled. It is recommended to isolate the models behind pokt-ml-sidecar and to front it with the HA RelayMiner. See the docs in specs[0] for the full runbook.
